name: CR 500 Temporary Road Closure Oct 7th 7p-10p
road:
UPDATE OCT 7th 10:35PM: CR 500 is anticipated to open to 1 lane at 11:00PM. Both lanes by 12:00AM OCT 8th. 

County Road 500 to Close October 7 for Emergency Culvert Replacement

La Plata County Road and Bridge Department will close County Road 500 to all traffic on Wednesday, October 7, from 7:00 p.m. to 10:00 p.m., to allow crews to replace the D Creek culvert located between the 1400 block of County Road 500 and Hope Lane.
This emergency replacement is being conducted on an expedited timeline to reinforce the crossing ahead of significant rainfall forecasted to begin Sunday, October 11. Completing the work before the storm system arrives is necessary to prevent potential culvert failure and to maintain safe road conditions.
There will be no alternate route available for homes north of the closure. Trust Drive remains impassable due to heavy runoff flowing into D Creek. Residents are advised to plan accordingly for the temporary closure.
